title: About Me
text:
I’m a data scientist passionate about sports analytics and driven by the opportunity to solve problems and collaborate as part of a team.
I’m a creative, analytically minded problem solver who enjoys exploring complex datasets, uncovering meaningful patterns, and turning data into clear, actionable insights. With strong Python skills and a focus on effective communication, I enjoy translating technical findings into ideas that are accessible to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Outside of work, I enjoy travelling, playing and watching sports, taking in local stand-up comedy shows, and exploring all that Vancouver has to offer!
For more details, check out my resume.

title: About Me
text:
Experience

Predictive Analyst · Sitewise Analytics
Vancouver, BC · Nov 2024 – Present

Contributed to 25+ predictive models this year using KNN, Random Forest, and XGBoost, covering data cleaning, feature engineering, and model evaluation.
Designed a new method to estimate sales distributions from zipcode-level customer delivery data, expanding the team’s modelling capabilities.
Automated dashboards that share model progress and key insights with leadership and clients, supporting data-driven decisions.
Moved key data preparation workflows from Alteryx to Python, improving efficiency and scalability for the team’s codebase.



Analyst · Statistics Canada
Ottawa, ON · Jan 2022 – Aug 2023

Coordinated data collection for the national Elementary-Secondary Education Survey with provincial ministries across Canada, gathering requirements from stakeholders at every level.
Analyzed large education datasets to identify enrollment trends and quantify the impact of COVID-19.
Authored the survey’s public release article, translating complex findings into accessible insights for a general audience.
